Target to secure ~INR 100 crores of data center EPC orders in FY27.
NOP 969 MW PM-KUSUM project: most of the project to be completed by end of FY27.
FY27 revenue mix expected to be ~60% solar, ~30% power T&D, ~10% water.

revisions.item: Management expects FY27 revenue of INR 2,200+ crores, with or without NOPL.

verdicts.item: Won INR 355 cr turnkey EPC for a 100 MW solar project (Ellume Energy) in Maharashtra, targeted for execution in ~11 months.
verdicts.note: Ellume 100 MW AC solar named among marquee solar EPC projects being executed; horizon Q3FY27 not yet due, no completion/progress detail.

verdicts.item: Expect to reach ~INR 2,000 cr-plus turnover next year (FY27) as the raised working capital is fully deployed.
With IPO-raised working capital, can support ~INR 2,500 cr of turnover without raising further working capital.
verdicts.note: Management reaffirms targeting up to INR2,500 cr turnover FY27 with no further equity dilution, consistent with WC-capacity claim; not yet realized. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Another INR 3,000-4,000 cr of bids already submitted and in the pipeline, expected to add fresh orders.
verdicts.note: Order book grew from ~INR4,000-4,500 cr to INR5,700 cr, so fresh orders added; specific INR3,000-4,000 cr bid pipeline figure not restated. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Full-year EBITDA margin expected to remain in line with the last 3 financial years (H1 optically lower on seasonality/fixed-cost absorption).
verdicts.note: Full-year EBITDA came at ~14%, marginally below the 15-17% last-3-yr range, attributed to reversible JJM receivable provisions; near but not fully in line.

verdicts.item: Adding solar is expected to hit blended margin only nominally, by about 1-2%, as only better-margin solar projects were chosen.
verdicts.note: Solar early-stage projects acknowledged to have modestly impacted blended margin; not quantified at exactly 1-2%, but overall margin held near range. [±10% rule]

verdicts.item: Current bank borrowing rate ~10%; expect finance cost/interest rate to improve on the A- upgrade.
verdicts.note: A- upgrade confirmed as the anticipated event; no specific finance-cost/borrowing-rate reduction from ~10% quantified.

verdicts.item: Working-capital deployment takes ~a year; positive operating cash flows expected from FY28 onwards.
verdicts.note: Management explicitly reaffirms positive operating cash flows expected from FY28; timeline held, outcome still future.

verdicts.item: Growth roadmap: expand into private-sector EPC, international markets (Africa, Middle East), irrigation/water, plus data centers and smart metering.
verdicts.note: Roadmap actively pursued: data center EPC entry (E&Y hired, ~INR100 cr target), evaluating Middle East/Africa, smart metering focus, selective water; progressing, none completed.
